Class CardPrinter

java.lang.Object
network.client.core.cli.view.CardPrinter
public class CardPrinter extends Object
Prints cards as ASCII boxes ("GUI-like" style) on the console. Encapsulates the matrix-of-strings layout logic so callers only pass CardDtos.
